name: Lying Leg Curl
summary: A machine isolation exercise that trains the hamstrings through knee flexion while you lie face down.
setup: Adjust the machine so your knees line up with the pivot and the pad sits just above your ankles.
Lie face down with your hips flat on the bench and hold the handles.
Pick a weight you can curl without lifting your hips.
execution: Curl your heels toward your glutes by bending your knees.
Squeeze your hamstrings at the top without letting your hips rise.
Lower the pad slowly over two to three seconds until your legs are almost straight.
Keep your hips pressed into the bench and avoid jerking the weight.
mistakes: Hips lifting off the bench: lighten the load and press your hips down.
Using momentum to swing the weight up: slow down and use a controlled tempo.
Cutting the lowering phase short: lower under control to nearly full extension.
Pad set too high on the calves: move it just above the ankles.
